translation: Подарок стал знаком доброй воли между двумя городами.

definition: happening slowly over a long period
sentence: There has been a {gradual} improvement in his health since the spring.
translation: С весны его здоровье постепенно улучшается.

definition: the regular movement of the heart as it pumps blood
sentence: The doctor listened to the baby's {heartbeat} through the mother's belly.
translation: Врач слушал сердцебиение ребёнка через живот матери.

definition: likely to happen very soon
sentence: With the storm {imminent}, the boats hurried back to the harbour.
translation: Поскольку буря была неминуема, лодки поспешили вернуться в гавань.

definition: happening at the start of something, or marking the start of a period in office
sentence: The president's {inaugural} speech promised peace and jobs.
translation: Инаугурационная речь президента обещала мир и рабочие места.

definition: material that stops heat, sound or electricity from passing through
sentence: Better {insulation} in the roof cut our heating bill in half.
translation: Лучшая изоляция крыши сократила наш счёт за отопление вдвое.

definition: not caring about the results of your actions
sentence: It was {irresponsible} to leave the children alone by the pool.
translation: Было безответственно оставить детей одних у бассейна.

definition: intending to harm or upset someone
sentence: Someone sent a {malicious} email pretending to be the bank.
translation: Кто-то прислал вредоносное письмо от имени банка.

definition: having large strong muscles, or relating to muscles
sentence: The {muscular} swimmer pulled himself out of the pool with one arm.
translation: Мускулистый пловец вытянул себя из бассейна одной рукой.

definition: the state of not supporting either side in a war or argument
sentence: The country has kept its {neutrality} through two world wars.
translation: Страна сохраняла нейтралитет на протяжении двух мировых войн.

definition: making a lot of loud sound
sentence: The {noisy} fridge keeps me awake at night.
translation: Шумный холодильник не даёт мне спать по ночам.

definition: not normal, different from others, sometimes in an interesting way
sentence: There's a {peculiar} smell coming from the fridge.
translation: Из холодильника идёт какой-то странный запах.

definition: a product sold under a brand name and owned by one company
sentence: The software is {proprietary}, so only the maker can change it.
translation: Программа проприетарная, поэтому изменять её может только производитель.

definition: an organ in a man's body near the bladder
sentence: Men over fifty should have their {prostate} checked regularly.
translation: Мужчинам старше пятидесяти следует регулярно проверять простату.

definition: an area of red spots on the skin caused by illness or something you touched
sentence: The baby has a {rash} on her arms from the new soap.
translation: У малышки сыпь на руках от нового мыла.

definition: fully grown and ready to be eaten, used of fruit and crops
sentence: The tomatoes are {ripe} and ready to pick.
translation: Помидоры созрели и готовы к сбору.

definition: the land along the edge of a river
sentence: We walked along the {riverside} until the lights of the town appeared.
translation: Мы шли вдоль берега реки, пока не показались огни города.

definition: having a healthy mind, or sensible and reasonable
sentence: No {sane} person would swim in that river in January.
translation: Ни один здравомыслящий человек не стал бы купаться в той реке в январе.

definition: a person who saves someone from danger or a bad situation
sentence: The young doctor became the {savior} of the whole village during the epidemic.
translation: Молодой врач стал спасителем всей деревни во время эпидемии.

definition: having beautiful views of nature
sentence: We took the {scenic} road along the coast instead of the motorway.
translation: Мы поехали по живописной дороге вдоль побережья вместо автомагистрали.

definition: according to figures and numbers
sentence: {Statistically}, flying is far safer than driving.
translation: Статистически летать гораздо безопаснее, чем ездить на машине.

definition: in an unusual or surprising way
sentence: The dog has been behaving {strangely} since the storm.
translation: Собака странно ведёт себя с самой грозы.

definition: likely to be affected by a disease or influenced by something
sentence: Young children are especially {susceptible} to ear infections.
translation: Маленькие дети особенно подвержены ушным инфекциям.

definition: dangerous or not protected
sentence: The old bridge was declared {unsafe} and closed to traffic.
translation: Старый мост признали небезопасным и закрыли для движения.

definition: the edge or border of something, or the point just before something happens
sentence: The company is on the {verge} of going bankrupt.
translation: Компания на грани банкротства.

definition: full of energy and life, or bright and strong in colour
sentence: The market is a {vibrant} mix of music, colour and shouting.
translation: Рынок — живая смесь музыки, красок и криков.

definition: a substance used to make bread rise and beer ferment
sentence: Mix the {yeast} with warm water and a little sugar.
translation: Смешай дрожжи с тёплой водой и небольшим количеством сахара.

definition: a tool with a wide blade and long handle for lifting earth or snow
sentence: He cleared the path with a {shovel} after the snowstorm.
translation: После метели он расчистил дорожку лопатой.

definition: a thick flat piece of stone, concrete or wood
sentence: The patio is made of grey concrete {slabs}.
translation: Терраса выложена серыми бетонными плитами.

definition: a person in charge of the objects in a museum or art gallery
sentence: The {curator} chose fifty paintings for the summer exhibition.
translation: Куратор отобрал пятьдесят картин для летней выставки.

definition: a plant with large red flowers and small black seeds
sentence: A single red {poppy} grew in the middle of the wheat field.
translation: Посреди пшеничного поля рос один красный мак.

definition: the act of digging in the ground to find old objects or make a hole
sentence: The {excavation} uncovered a Roman road under the car park.
translation: Раскопки обнаружили римскую дорогу под парковкой.

definition: to use your hands awkwardly when trying to hold or find something
sentence: She began to {fumble} in her bag for the keys.
translation: Она стала неловко рыться в сумке в поисках ключей.

definition: to hit something or someone while moving
sentence: Two lorries managed to {collide} on the empty road at midnight.
translation: Два грузовика умудрились столкнуться на пустой дороге в полночь.

definition: a card with a picture on one side, sent by post without an envelope
sentence: She sent us a {postcard} of the harbour from Lisbon.
translation: Она прислала нам из Лиссабона открытку с видом гавани.

definition: a person or group with an interest in the success of a company or project
sentence: Every {stakeholder} from staff to suppliers was asked for an opinion.
translation: Мнение спросили у всех заинтересованных сторон, от сотрудников до поставщиков.

definition: a person who performs tricks that seem impossible to entertain people
sentence: The {magician} pulled a rabbit from an empty hat.
translation: Фокусник вытащил кролика из пустой шляпы.

definition: a change that makes something untrue or unclear, or a change of shape
sentence: The article was a {distortion} of what she actually said.
translation: Статья исказила то, что она на самом деле сказала.

definition: a condition in which part of the body or mind does not work fully
sentence: She was born with a hearing {impairment} and reads lips.
translation: Она родилась с нарушением слуха и читает по губам.

definition: to have an unpleasant feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch
sentence: Wool always makes my neck {itch} in winter.
translation: От шерсти у меня чешется шея.

definition: to pull something suddenly and hard
sentence: The child began to {tug} at her mother's sleeve.
translation: Ребёнок начал дёргать мать за рукав.

definition: the act of forcing a foreign person to leave a country
sentence: The family faced {deportation} after their visa expired.
translation: После истечения визы семье грозила депортация.

definition: a person who rides horses in races
sentence: The {jockey} fell at the last fence but was not hurt.
translation: Жокей упал на последнем барьере, но не пострадал.

definition: relating to powers of the spirit beyond what science can explain
sentence: Pilgrims believe the spring has {mystic} healing powers.
translation: Паломники верят, что источник обладает мистической целебной силой.

definition: a scientist who studies matter, energy and how they interact
sentence: The {physicist} explained black holes to a room of children.
translation: Физик объяснила чёрные дыры целому залу детей.

definition: to change the design of something
sentence: The company will {redesign} the website to work better on phones.
translation: Компания переделает сайт, чтобы он лучше работал на телефонах.

definition: to shock someone deeply
sentence: The state of the kitchen will {appall} the health inspector.
translation: Состояние кухни ужаснёт санитарного инспектора.

definition: to fall or flow downwards in large amounts, like a waterfall
sentence: Water began to {cascade} down the stairs from the burst pipe.
translation: Вода хлынула вниз по лестнице из лопнувшей трубы.

definition: a large round hole in the ground made by an explosion or a falling rock
sentence: The bomb left a {crater} ten metres wide in the road.
translation: Бомба оставила в дороге воронку шириной десять метров.

definition: a large case with a handle for carrying clothes when you travel
sentence: My {suitcase} was lost somewhere between Paris and Rome.
translation: Мой чемодан потерялся где-то между Парижем и Римом.

definition: to change something to suit a particular person or purpose
sentence: You can {customize} the app by choosing your own colours and sounds.
translation: Приложение можно настроить под себя, выбрав свои цвета и звуки.

definition: to calculate an answer or amount using a machine or mathematics
sentence: The program can {compute} the route in less than a second.
translation: Программа может вычислить маршрут меньше чем за секунду.

definition: an official who lives in a foreign city to help people from their own country
sentence: The {consul} helped the tourists replace their stolen passports.
translation: Консул помог туристам восстановить украденные паспорта.

definition: a bright green precious stone
sentence: The ring held a small {emerald} surrounded by diamonds.
translation: В кольце был небольшой изумруд в окружении бриллиантов.

definition: a small lump of something valuable such as gold, or a small piece of information
sentence: The old miner found a gold {nugget} the size of his thumb.
translation: Старый шахтёр нашёл золотой самородок размером с большой палец.

definition: to say a poem or piece of text aloud from memory
sentence: Each child had to {recite} a poem in front of the class.
translation: Каждый ребёнок должен был прочитать стихотворение наизусть перед классом.

definition: a period when all electric lights go off, or a short loss of consciousness
sentence: The storm caused a {blackout} across the whole city.
translation: Из-за бури весь город остался без света.

definition: a flat round piece of minced meat or vegetables, often in a burger
sentence: The cook flipped the beef {patty} and added cheese.
translation: Повар перевернул говяжью котлету и добавил сыр.

definition: to fasten a belt or strap, or to bend because of heat or weight
sentence: {Buckle} your seat belt before the car starts.
translation: Пристегни ремень, прежде чем машина тронется.

definition: to use something in the wrong way or for the wrong purpose
sentence: Staff who {misuse} company cars will lose them.
translation: Сотрудники, использующие служебные машины не по назначению, их лишатся.

definition: the distance north or south of the equator, or freedom to act as you choose
sentence: At this {latitude} the sun never sets in June.
translation: На этой широте солнце в июне никогда не заходит.

definition: a small electronic machine for doing sums
sentence: You may use a {calculator} in the second part of the exam.
translation: Во второй части экзамена можно пользоваться калькулятором.

definition: a pipe or passage that carries smoke from a fire up through the roof
sentence: Smoke rose from the {chimney} of the little cottage.
translation: Из трубы маленького домика поднимался дым.

definition: the process of taking in a liquid, gas or energy, or complete attention
sentence: Vitamin C helps the {absorption} of iron from food.
translation: Витамин C помогает усвоению железа из пищи.

definition: a skin condition with many red spots, common among teenagers
sentence: The doctor gave her a cream for the {acne} on her forehead.
translation: Врач выписал ей крем от прыщей на лбу.

definition: a strong negative reaction to a change or event
sentence: The new tax caused a {backlash} from small businesses.
translation: Новый налог вызвал резкую ответную реакцию малого бизнеса.

definition: thick stiff paper used for making boxes
sentence: The books arrived in a large {cardboard} box.
translation: Книги пришли в большой картонной коробке.

definition: in a relaxed way, or without planning or care
sentence: He {casually} mentioned that he had won the lottery.
translation: Он как бы между прочим упомянул, что выиграл в лотерею.

definition: happening as an extra result of something else, often unexpected or unwanted
sentence: The factory's closure did {collateral} damage to every shop in the town.
translation: Закрытие завода нанесло побочный ущерб каждому магазину в городе.

definition: a situation in which a road or place is too full of traffic or people
sentence: Traffic {congestion} in the centre is worst between five and six.
translation: Пробки в центре хуже всего между пятью и шестью.

definition: the period of the day when it is light
sentence: The owl sleeps in the {daytime} and hunts at night.
translation: Сова спит днём и охотится ночью.

definition: the end or death of something, especially a business or organisation
sentence: The {demise} of the local paper left the town without news.
translation: Закрытие местной газеты оставило город без новостей.

definition: the state of needing someone or something in order to survive or succeed
sentence: The region's {dependence} on tourism became a problem when flights stopped.
translation: Зависимость региона от туризма стала проблемой, когда прекратились полёты.

definition: very serious or extremely bad
sentence: The hospital is in {dire} need of more nurses.
translation: Больница остро нуждается в медсёстрах.

definition: towards the bottom of a hill, or getting worse
sentence: From the church the path runs {downhill} to the river.
translation: От церкви тропа спускается под гору к реке.

definition: extremely bad or unpleasant
sentence: The weather was {dreadful}, with rain every single day.
translation: Погода была ужасная, дождь шёл каждый день.

definition: drunk, or caused by being drunk
sentence: A {drunken} argument outside the pub ended in a fight.
translation: Пьяный спор у паба закончился дракой.

definition: very serious and sincere
sentence: The {earnest} young teacher stayed late to help every pupil.
translation: Серьёзная молодая учительница оставалась допоздна, чтобы помочь каждому ученику.

definition: no longer existing, used of animals and plants
sentence: The dodo has been {extinct} for more than three hundred years.
translation: Дронт вымер больше трёхсот лет назад.

definition: a large box or cupboard kept very cold for storing frozen food
sentence: Put the ice cream in the {freezer} before it melts.
translation: Положи мороженое в морозилку, пока оно не растаяло.

definition: in a way that relates to genes
sentence: The corn has been {genetically} changed to resist insects.
translation: Кукуруза генетически изменена, чтобы противостоять насекомым.

definition: given as an honour without the usual duties or requirements
sentence: The university gave the singer an {honorary} degree in music.
translation: Университет присвоил певице почётную степень по музыке.

definition: acting like a child, or not fully grown
sentence: It was {immature} of him to hide her keys as a joke.
translation: Было незрело с его стороны спрятать её ключи ради шутки.

definition: extremely important and urgent
sentence: It is {imperative} that the patient gets water every hour.
translation: Крайне важно, чтобы пациент получал воду каждый час.

definition: not producing the result that was wanted
sentence: The old medicine proved {ineffective} against the new virus.
translation: Старое лекарство оказалось неэффективным против нового вируса.

definition: having qualities traditionally thought typical of a man, such as strength
sentence: He thought crying was not {manly} and hid his tears.
translation: Он считал, что плакать не по-мужски, и прятал слёзы.

definition: the state of being a mother, or care for women having babies
sentence: She is on {maternity} leave until the baby is six months old.
translation: Она в декретном отпуске, пока ребёнку не исполнится полгода.

definition: bad or dishonest behaviour by a person in a position of responsibility
sentence: The doctor was struck off for professional {misconduct}.
translation: Врача лишили лицензии за профессиональные нарушения.

definition: not necessary and so able to be avoided
sentence: The delay caused {needless} worry for the whole family.
translation: Задержка причинила ненужное беспокойство всей семье.

definition: the quality of being new and unusual, or a small cheap toy
sentence: The {novelty} of the electric car wore off after a month.
translation: Новизна электромобиля прошла через месяц.

definition: the belief that good things will happen in the future
sentence: Despite the rain, there was {optimism} that the match would go ahead.
translation: Несмотря на дождь, все надеялись, что матч состоится.

definition: the process of making something work as well as possible
sentence: Search {optimization} brought more visitors to the site than the ads did.
translation: Поисковая оптимизация привела на сайт больше посетителей, чем реклама.

definition: no longer useful or modern
sentence: The office still runs on {outdated} software from 2005.
translation: Офис до сих пор работает на устаревшей программе 2005 года.

definition: pictures, films or writing designed to cause sexual excitement
sentence: The law makes it a crime to show {pornography} to children.
translation: По закону показывать порнографию детям — преступление.

definition: the fact of something being common or widespread
sentence: The {prevalence} of asthma is higher in cities than in the country.
translation: Астма более распространена в городах, чем в сельской местности.

definition: arranged for the present time but likely to be changed later
sentence: The dates are {provisional} until the hall confirms the booking.
translation: Даты предварительные, пока зал не подтвердит бронирование.

definition: to make something completely wet, or to fill it so nothing more can be added
sentence: Heavy rain will {saturate} the soil and cause landslides.
translation: Сильный дождь пропитает почву и вызовет оползни.

definition: a game like baseball played with a larger softer ball
sentence: The office {softball} team plays on Thursday evenings.
translation: Офисная команда по софтболу играет по четвергам вечером.

definition: in or from the south-east of a place
sentence: The {southeastern} corner of the country is the driest.
translation: Юго-восточный угол страны самый засушливый.

definition: behaviour that shows a lack of good sense or intelligence
sentence: It was pure {stupidity} to drive after drinking.
translation: Сесть за руль после выпивки было чистой глупостью.

definition: real and able to be seen, touched or measured
sentence: The new road brought {tangible} benefits: shorter journeys and more jobs.
translation: Новая дорога принесла ощутимую пользу: короче путь и больше рабочих мест.

definition: small and not important
sentence: We argued about something {trivial}, like whose turn to cook.
translation: Мы поспорили из-за какой-то мелочи вроде того, чья очередь готовить.

definition: not approved or done by someone in authority
